name: Hyperbrowser
description: Hyperbrowser is an advanced AI-powered tool designed to enhance your web browsing experience with intelligent features and seamless integration.

events.d: Extract structured data from one or more web pages using your extraction prompt. Returns results in JSON and supports options like CAPTCHA solving and stealth browsing.
Crawls a website and returns structured page data.

Extract readable content, links, HTML or screenshots from a web page URL. Options allow including/excluding selectors, extracting only the main content, and enabling CAPTCHA solving or stealth browsing.
